run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the Kth distinct non-repeating element in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use collections.Counter instead of a manual dictionary
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases where no Kth distinct element exists
